# kb-projection — Roadmap

_Introspected from the `bd` issue graph on 2026-07-15. Generated, not hand-written — it cannot drift from the tracker. Edit the template (`docs/templates/ROADMAP.md`), not this output; run `make roadmap` (or `DocExpand --config .claude/skill-data/DocGen.json`) to regenerate._

## What this is

**kb-projection** is the extracted projection engine behind the `_KNOWLEDGE_PROJECT` skill (`@kyber/kb-projection`) — it projects a curated LogSeq/KB subgraph into format-specific artifacts (Astro sites, Obsidian) that are **derived and regenerable**, with the graph as the source of truth. Alongside the projection engine it hosts the **region-addressing substrate**: name-addressable content regions plus the reconciler that keeps *projected* regions faithful to source while leaving *non-projected* (freely-authored) regions untouched.

The core model (locked 2026-07-15): a page is a set of regions, some **projected** (source-owned — divergence is regenerated, source-wins; grounded pages gated via the canonical `kb_cli faithfulness-gate`), the rest **non-projected** (a free surface anyone — human or agent — may edit). See epic `kb-projection-6ji`.
